script_text: Stop! Pisces, the stars are screaming at you right now. Neptune, your ruling planet, is forming a tense square to Mars in your 7th House of Partnerships, creating friction in your relationships. At the same time, the Moon in your 1st House amplifies your water element, sharpening your intuition. If you're single, this energy draws a partner who respects your dreamy nature; if you're taken, watch for unresolved arguments surfacing. You may find yourself drawn to creative pursuits that deepen your emotional connection. Jupiter's trine to your 10th House of Professional Status opens a door to a promotion, and the Sun in your 2nd House hints at a bonus. Consider networking in artistic circles, as Mars in your 11th House of Friendships brings collaborative chances. Beware of letting emotional turbulence cloud your judgment, yet a surprise invitation could elevate your social standing. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
